personality_one_liner: Um utilitário limpo, focado e confiável que coloca a escala de enfermagem em primeiro plano sem distrações.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for readability. Clear grouping of elements. Use exact scale tokens.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Use on bottom-sheet headers and drag handles
Apply to sticky headers if overlapping with the calendar grid
dont's: Do not use on regular list rows or data entry form fields

screens.name: Home / Calendário
screens.purpose: A full-month view showing the 12x36 shift sequence at a glance, allowing users to tap any day to swap/edit.

states.loading: A skeleton of the monthly grid with a subtle pulse.
states.empty: No initial shift set. Shows a prominent CTA: 'Configurar minha escala 12x36'.
states.error: Failed to load schedule. Button to retry.

screens.layout: Sticky header with Month/Year selector. The core is a responsive 7-column calendar grid. Each cell shows the day number and a color block/dot representing SD (BLUE), SN (RED), or Folga (Grey). Below the calendar, show a 'Próximo Plantão' (Next Shift) card with a glass effect.

screens.name: Editar Plantão (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Contextual action sheet to swap a shift (SD to SN, or Vice-Versa) and edit working hours for a specific day.

states.loading: Centered loading spinner when saving changes.
states.empty: N/A - opens with pre-filled context of the selected day.
states.error: Error updating shift with a retry option.

screens.layout: Triggered from the Home Calendar. Header with the selected Date. A segmented control or large pill buttons for [SD (Blue), SN (Red), Folga]. Below that, a form with Start and End time pickers, and an optional 'Colega de troca' (Colleague swap) text input. A sticky primary button 'Salvar Alteração' pinned to the bottom.

screens.name: Relatórios
screens.purpose: View calculated monthly work hours and shifts completed across multiple workplaces.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'Nenhum plantão registrado este mês'.

screens.layout: A scrollable list of months with summarized data. Each row shows Total Hours, number of SD shifts, and number of SN shifts. Uses clean iOS list grouping with native spacing.

screens.name: Locais de Trabalho
screens.purpose: Manage multiple hospitals/clinics, setting distinct colors or labels for each location's calendar layer.

states.empty: Shows an illustration of a hospital and 'Adicione seu primeiro local de trabalho'.

screens.layout: A simple list view with cards for each workplace (e.g., 'Hospital São Lucas'). Floating Action Button with glass effect to 'Add Novo Local'.

empty_calendar.alt: Empty calendar flatlay indicating no data

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color requirement for shifts: SD (Shift Day) must be rendered in BLUE (`shiftDay`: #007AFF) and SN (Shift Night) must be rendered in RED (`shiftNight`: #FF3B30). This overrides any general color bans.
Implement the calendar layout prioritizing scanability. Do not use generic lists for the schedule; use a month grid.
Use `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` for the shift edit/swap interactions to avoid navigating users away from the calendar context.
Apply iOS-native UI aesthetics (Personality 1): use clear grouping for list items, generous padding (e.g., md or lg) inside cards, and keep the typography highly legible (Plus Jakarta Sans).
Keep touch targets at least 44x44pt on the calendar grid.
Do not use emojis in the UI text (e.g., no hospital or calendar emojis).
Make sure all wording is in Portuguese (Brazil).
